correctness.rationale: Every source component is connected by coordinate-change relations, so forth forces a unique target component. For each output coordinate u, forth for all other relations forces dependence only on the source u-coordinate; each back condition is equivalent to that coordinate map being surjective. This proves the exact q_ij weights for arbitrary r>=2. Weighted inclusion–exclusion counts each exact image support, and an idempotent must fix its whole image pointwise. Coordinatewise minimality forces the hitting condition, while choosing selected minimal components constructs an explicit idempotent for every admissible support. Empty and repeated-type cases are handled by ordinary empty-product conventions. Verification code ran 23,249 raw two-modal functions and 7,022 raw three-modal functions and checked 320 distinct normal-form maps on the ten-world example. Computations test finite cases only; the displayed proof is the general argument.

value.rationale: The finite product frames are natural models of multiple commuting S5 modalities and diagonal-free cylindric set algebras. Counting endomorphism images and retracts is a structural finite-algebra invariant, and coordinatewise partial ordering generates multiple incomparable mandatory minimal types not present in the one-modal minimum-cluster theorem. The simultaneous exact unrestricted/idempotent rank polynomials classify every finite dimension-vector multiset and give explicit finite arithmetic algorithms and a complete characterization of achievable compression sizes. This is a motivated complete classification rather than a tiny isolated numerical census.
